prompt: When the maker of the third-party console title "ActRaiser", merged with the makers of the console title "Chrono Trigger", what percentage of the company did the makers of "ActRaiser" make up?
answer:
The makers of **ActRaiser, Enix**, made up approximately **55.25%** of the merged company.

Calculation:

\[
\frac{1}{1+0.81}\times 100 \approx 55.25\%
\]

Square, the maker of *Chrono Trigger*, therefore represented about **44.75%**.
